test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Why is it not easy to draw a line between old media and new media?

options.text: Because new media can be customised to users’ preferences
Because new media is considered to be the multimedia and digital form of communication
Because both include various kinds of medium
Because old media has found new ways of representation in digital forms

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The statement discusses** the difficulty in drawing a clear line between old media and new media.**
 
• This is** primarily** because old media has adapted to** the digital age **by finding new ways of representation in digital formats.
 
• This **evolution blurs the distinction between old and new media, making it challenging to categorize them separately.**
 
• This aligns with** option 4**, which states** that old media has found new ways of representation in digital forms.**
 
• In summary,** option 4 best explains the reason for the difficulty in distinguishing between old and new media** by highlighting how old media has adapted to digital forms. Options 1, 2, and 3 either describe features of new media or general characteristics that do not directly address the core issue.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Because new media can be customised to users’ preferences:** While it is true that new media offers customization, this feature does not explain the difficulty in distinguishing between old and new media.
 
• **Because new media is considered to be the multimedia and digital form of communication:** This option describes what new media is but does not address why it is difficult to differentiate it from old media.
 
• **Because both include various kinds of medium:** Although both old and new media encompass various forms of media, this fact alone does not explain the challenge in drawing a line between them.
